title: The Msasa Tree — EN/SN/ZU (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Zulu heritage nature seasons
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The msasa tree turns red before the rains in Zimbabwe
A signal understood by every creature and every day
That the dry season's ending and the wet is on its way
The msasa tree is the first thing that knows what the clouds will say

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Muti weMsasa unofuka tsvuku usati mvura yarova
[The msasa tree turns red before the rains come]
Chiratidzo ichi chinonyatsozivikanwa nenyika yose yova
[This signal is known by every creature of the land]
Mvura ichauya — nyika yose inoziva izvi
[The rains are coming — all the land knows this]
Muti weMsasa ndiwo unofungira mvura kufika
[The msasa tree is the one that anticipates the rain's arrival]

[Chorus — English]
The msasa tree, the msasa tree
Turning red on the kopjes before the rain is free
The msasa knows October like no calendar could say
The msasa tree is burning red — the rains are on their way

[Bridge — Zulu, with English translation]
Umuthi weMsasa uba bomvu ngaphambi kwezimvula eZimbabwe
[The msasa tree turns red before the rains in Zimbabwe]
Leli uphawu olwaziwa izilwane zonke nenhlabathi yonke
[This signal is known by all animals and all the earth]
Izimvula ziyeza — izwe lonke liyazi lesi siqiniseko
[The rains are coming — the whole land knows this certainty]
UMsasa uyazi uNovemba ngaphambi kwamakhalenda
[The msasa knows November before any calendar]

[Outro — All three languages]
Msasa knows… Muti weMsasa unoziva… UMsasa uyazi
October burning red — Gumiguru richisvibuka — UNovemba uvutha obomvu
The gardens still growing
